cause_of_death: P-03 discriminating experiment FAILED. 0/4 scenarios discriminating. Both with-floor and without-floor survived 48h in all scenarios. Per CEO R311 P5: 'the candidate's claimed advantage is unsupported.' Per Article XXXVI §4: redesign was the one repair attempt; second failure is terminal.

reusable_negative_knowledge.headline: Residual conductance floor provides marginal peak ICP improvement (0.7-1.8 mmHg) but NO survival difference under obstruction/low-pressure scenarios.
reusable_negative_knowledge.root_cause: Floor conductance (0.001 mL/min/mmHg) too small. At ICP=25 mmHg, floor provides only 0.025 mL/min drainage — <10% of CSF production (0.30 mL/min). Cannot prevent ICP rise, only slows it slightly.
reusable_negative_knowledge.implication: Any residual-conductance safety mechanism must provide drainage comparable to CSF production rate (>0.1 mL/min) to be clinically meaningful. Peak ICP reduction without survival improvement is NOT sufficient.
